# @moku-labs/editor

> Editor, devtools and MCP layer for @moku-labs/game, built on @moku-labs/core. Three Moku cores in one package: `editor-agent` on the game page, `editor-server` in Bun, `editor-tools` on the tools page. One registry of sources and commands feeds the in-game overlay, the tools page and headless tests. The editor reaches the game only through `@moku-labs/game/inspect` and `@moku-labs/game/control` (plus the game's `.dev` modules). ESM only. Bun for the server; browser for the agent and the tools page.

- Package: `@moku-labs/editor` (MIT)
- Peer dependencies: `@moku-labs/game >= 0.10.0` and `typescript >= 5.5`, both required (the project index, `@moku-labs/game/project`, needs `typescript`; the engine page, `@moku-labs/game/cli` `preparePage`, needs game 0.10.0)
- Doors: element rects come from `game.locate { key }` when the manifest lists it (0.4), else `game.rect { key }` (0.1); neither listed: nothing is read and the picker says "This game reports no element rects". `game.capture` answers a PNG data URL (0.1) or `{ png, legend? }` (0.4); capture takes both. The contact sheet (`editor.sheet`, MCP `moku_series`) needs game 0.4.
- Runtime dependencies: `@moku-labs/core`, `@moku-labs/common`, `preact`, `elkjs`
- Bin, engine page (B5): `moku-editor [--root DIR] [--preload FILE]… [--serve-plugin FILE]…` with no html, in a moku-game folder (`index.ts` + `config.ts`): the bin imports `@moku-labs/game/cli` from the game root, calls `preparePage(root, { agents: ["@moku-labs/editor/agent/page"], preload, servePlugins })` (paths resolved against the cwd), and always re-runs itself as `bun --config=<root>/.moku/bunfig.toml <bin> <root>/.moku/index.html --root <root>` in the root (D-51), so Bun loads the engine's hot plugin. Not a moku-game folder: exit 2; the engine refuses: its `[game] …` message, exit 1. From an editor working tree the bin appends `<tree>/scripts/tree/bundle.ts` to the serve plugins (D-50): the page bundles the tree's `dist/` on the game's one engine copy. `--preload` and `--serve-plugin` with an html file, or on `mcp` / `mcp-config`, are errors.
- Bin, html: `moku-editor <game-html> [--port 3000] [--root .] [--no-hmr] [--help]` (Bun only). Serves with Bun hot reload on (D-23); `--no-hmr` starts it off, and the Hot reload switch flips it while the bin runs (D-32). Bun reads `[serve.static]` of `bunfig.toml` from the process cwd only, so when `--root` holds such a bunfig and the cwd is another folder the bin re-runs itself in the root: run it from anywhere. `moku-editor mcp [<game-html>] [--port N] [--root DIR] [--no-hmr]` is the stdio MCP server for Claude Code; `moku-editor mcp-config [<game-html>] [--port N]` prints its `.mcp.json` snippet and `claude mcp add` line.
- Bin, e2e (D-52): `moku-editor e2e -c <playwright config> [playwright args…]` runs a game's editor Playwright specs with one Playwright process, so one fresh editor bin, per project, because Bun 1.3.14's dev server crashes after many hot reloads in one process; each project on its own `PORT` (`PORT`, else 4417, plus its index), an explicit `--project` or `--list` runs once, a project with no test for the filter passes (`--pass-with-no-tests`), other words go to Playwright, `CI=true` installs Chromium first, exit = the first failing code.
- Full reference: llms-full.txt (every Config, Api and event type verbatim). Both llms files ship in the package.
- Built for a narrow pane: Claude's browser pane at 1/3 (480 px) or 1/2 (720 px) of the screen; every workspace works at 480 px.

## Entry points

| Import | What |
|---|---|
| `@moku-labs/editor` | Runtime-free: wire protocol types and pure helpers, `definePanel` and panel types. Imports no plugin and no core. |
| `@moku-labs/editor/agent` | Agent core for the game page. `createApp`, `createPlugin`, `registryPlugin`, `channelPlugin`, `overlayPlugin`, `bridgePlugin`, `capturePlugin`; namespaces `Registry`, `Channel`, `Overlay`, `Bridge`, `Capture`. |
| `@moku-labs/editor/agent/page` | Default export only: the engine's `PageAgent` (D-49). `moku-game dev` and the bin's engine page call it after the game started: it stops a previous `globalThis.editor`, starts the agent core with `bridgePlugin` and `capturePlugin` on `{ app, name, modules }` and sets `globalThis.editor`. No side effect on import. |
| `@moku-labs/editor/server` | Server core for Bun. `createApp`, `createPlugin`, `filesPlugin`, `hubPlugin`, `pagesPlugin`; namespaces `Files`, `Hub`, `Pages`. |
| `@moku-labs/editor/tools` | Tools core for the tools page. `createApp`, `createPlugin`, `linkPlugin`, `workspacePlugin`, `panelsPlugin`, `flowViewPlugin`, `gameViewPlugin`, `renderViewPlugin`, `stateViewPlugin`, `filesViewPlugin`, `consoleViewPlugin`; namespaces `Link`, `Workspace`, `Panels`, `FlowView`, `GameView`, `RenderView`, `StateView`, `FilesView`, `ConsoleView`. |

## Core concepts

- Three cores (decision D-01): `src/config.ts` has three `createCoreConfig` calls, each with its own Config and global Events. Each runtime gets its own bundle: Bun code never reaches the browser, Preact never reaches the server.
- Every core registers the core plugins `logPlugin` and `envPlugin` from `@moku-labs/common`: `ctx.log` and `ctx.env` on every plugin.
- Global configs `AgentConfig`, `ServerConfig`, `ToolsConfig` are empty. Every option belongs to a plugin and is set through `pluginConfigs` (shallow merge; arrays replace).
- Registry: the doors and `.dev` modules become closure-erased entries. Raw `Json` in, `checkInput` against the descriptor's `InputSchema`, door call, `toWireValue` out.
- Manifest: descriptors only (`sources`, `commands`), plus `game`, `page`, `embedded`. Sent by the bridge in `hello`.
- Not installed: the registry probes every door source once with its default input at start and on each manifest rebuild (never `game.rect` or `game.locate`, which locate one element). A door that throws (a game without `effectsPlugin`, a screenless game without `ui`/`world`, game 0.4.2's `game.sounds` without `audioPlugin`: `[game] The source game.sounds needs audioPlugin.`) is listed with `available: false` and `reason`; its reads and watches answer -32008 `not_installed` (not retryable). The link neither logs nor retries it; Render reads "Effects not installed in this game".
- Production builds: import the agent only inside `if (__MOKU_GAME_DEV__) { await import("@moku-labs/editor/agent") }`. With the flag `false` the bundle keeps no editor code; the package is `"sideEffects": false` and the agent core is `/* @__PURE__ */`.
- EditorChannel: `read`, `watch`, `run`, `status`. In process it is the agent `channel`; remote it is the tools `link`. Every panel reads through it.
- Source `changes`: `frame` (re-read by the bridge once per heartbeat), `commit`, `edge` (followed by watch). Values are sent only when their JSON text changed.
- Command `effect`: `read`, `route`, `cosmetic`, `cheat`, `raw`. Editor-owned commands (`editor.*`) cannot be `cheat` or `raw`.
- Sessions: one per connected game page, id `s-` + 4 hex. Tools pick one: sticky choice, then this tab's own game frame (`__editorFrame`), then newest embedded, then newest.
- Heartbeat: `{ frame, paused, at, heap? }`; `heap { usedMb, limitMb }` only in Chromium. Taps: the bridge sends `tap { x, y, at }` per pointerdown (at most one per 50 ms); `link.onTap` gets them; workspace draws ripples.
- Tools page: Game is the default workspace; ⌘1–⌘6 = Game, Flow, Render, State, Files, Console. Density `auto` (compact below 820 px) / `compact` / `comfortable`. Reference mode (key R) lays `data-moku-*` proxies over the game elements; the cursor over the game is a crosshair, a click picks one element and a drag of 4 px or more picks an area, in Select mode too (`area-f<frame>.md`: the elements fully inside, else the ones covered by half; group roots, top to bottom, at most 40; each with its child tree (two spaces per level, 3 levels, 60 lines), `text "…"` when the game reports one and `x,y w×h px` bounds; one `layout:` line per parent chain, `partly in the area:` (at most 8) and `## <key> · component <Name> · <file:line>` for each component used). The pinned preview plays the game; S/M/L sizes it. Views' side panels are one `SidePanel` (resize, collapse, close, reopen, overlay drawer).
- Top bar (round 2, 2b R15): from 900 px it shows the Preview (G), Overlay (O) and Hot reload (H) switches with labels, Reference mode, Registry (icon; counts in its title) and theme. Below 900 px it is compact: logo, game name, link pill (session in its title), Pause and Step as icons (labels are their accessible names), the Reference mode icon toggle (target, `aria-pressed`, R) and the Hot reload icon toggle (flame with a dot while on, H), a search icon and a ⋯ menu (`data-action="more"`) holding Game preview, Overlay in game, Reference mode, Hot reload, Registry, Density and Theme, each with its state and key. At 560 px and narrower the game name and the Hot reload icon go (Hot reload stays in ⋯). The icons share the `data-action` of the menu rows: `[data-ui=top-bar] > [data-action=reference]`, `[data-ui=more-menu] [data-action=reference]`.
- Pick for the chat (round 2, 2b R13): a picker click or a Reference proxy click bookmarks the game (`gameView.bookmarks()`), saves `<day>/<key>-f<frame>-crop.jpg` (the element + 8 px) and `<day>/f<frame>-full.jpg` (the frame; JPEG 0.8 by default, D-34), writes the card `<day>/<key>-f<frame>.md` (`-2` … when taken that day); `<day>` is today's folder `<capturesDir>/<yyyy-mm-dd>` (local date), where Shot (`<hhmm>-<flow>.jpg`) and Series (`series-<hhmm>/`) write too; old flat files stay and puts ONE line on the clipboard. "Copy reference" in the Element tab writes the card of the selection again and copies its line (`copyReference()` returns it):

  ```text
  @moku settingsBoard panel · settingsPopup/open · features/settings/settings.tsx:290 · ref 65,641 950×1060 · .moku/captures/2026-10-05/settingsBoard-f212.md
  ```

  Line fields: name and type, flow/node, the `file:line` of the key (an entity: the line that defines its projection), `ref` bounds in the game's reference units, the card path; an unknown field is left out. The card is Markdown: `# @moku <name> <type>`, the full reference block in a `text` fence, `## JSX · <file:line>` and `## Style · <name> · <file:line>` fenced snippets (an entity: `## Spawned by <projection> · <file:line>` and its components), then `![element](<key>-f<frame>-crop.jpg)` and `![frame](f<frame>-full.jpg)`. The block in the card:

  ```text
  @moku settingsBoard · panel · settingsPopup/open · f212
  path: settingsScreen/settingsBoard
  source: features/settings/settings.tsx:290 · texture: ui.panel-signboard
  layout: settingsScreen (column, padding 0/0/0/0)
  bounds: 24,233 346×386 px · ref 65,641 950×1060
  state: visible
  flow: board > settings > open · last: board/settings/enter → done
  game: merge-game 0.0.0 · s-1f12 · f212 · 15:31:13 · live · clean
  device: iPhone 15 393×852 portrait · dpr 3 · safe 59/0/34/0
  restore: bookmark settingsBoard-f210
  shot: .moku/captures/2026-10-05/settingsBoard-f212-crop.jpg · frame: .moku/captures/2026-10-05/f212-full.jpg
  ```

  An unknown line or field is left out. `bounds` is device px, then the game's reference units (`SceneNode.refRect`). `restore` names the kept bookmark: `panels.run("game.restore", { bookmark: gameView.bookmarks()[0].value })` goes back to it.
- Devices (round 2b R9, R10): twenty-one presets grouped iPhone (SE 3 · small, 2022 with the home-button frame, 15, 17e approx, Air approx, 18 Pro approx — the default, 18 Pro Max approx, then 15 Pro Max, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max), Android (Galaxy S24, Galaxy A55, Redmi Note 13 approx, Pixel 8, Xperia 1 V 21:9), Foldable (Galaxy Z Fold 6 approx, Galaxy Z Flip 6, Pixel 9 Pro Fold approx, iPhone Duo approx: cover 466×678, inner 890×626 landscape-wide; the folding ones with Fold/Unfold), Tablet (iPad mini 7, iPad Air 11"), Desktop. Each has `dpr`, safe insets (Android, foldable and tablet report 0), a screen `radius` and `frame` (`"modern"` | `"home-button"`); the docked frame is clipped round. Fit is one scale per kind (the tallest preset of the kind, bezel included), so an SE shows smaller than an 18 Pro Max; foldables are phones; 100 % is 1 CSS px per px.
- Game toolbar (round 2b): a Sound switch (key M in Game) runs `game.mute { muted }` when the manifest lists it and keeps the flag (`workspace.muted()`, `setMuted(on)`, re-applied to every game that connects); without `game.mute` (game before 0.4.4) it is dimmed, title "Needs @moku-labs/game with game.mute". The Element tab's Code section (`data-part="code"`) shows the picked element's JSX and its `defineStyle` block with `file:line`, Open in Files and highlighting (20 lines, then "Show all N lines"); an entity shows "Spawned by <projection> · <file:line>" and its components. The capture card (Shot, pick, Series) is compact: a 56 px thumbnail, one line each for the title, the path (cut in the middle, the whole path in `title`) and `f<frame> · <device>`, then Copy link, Open and (a pick) Reference; at most 360 × 120 px.
- LinkStatus: `connecting`, `live { frame }`, `paused { frame }`, `silent { since, lastFrame }`, `lost { reason, lastFrame, retryInMs }`, `empty`.
- Panels are data (D-04): `definePanel` returns a frozen spec; the `panels` host owns subscriptions, first-value waiting, stale marking, teardown.
- Views never depend on each other (D-13): cross-view intents are global tools events (`workspace:open-file`, `workspace:select-node`, …).
- One game iframe (D-14): `workspace` owns it and never moves it in the DOM; views dock it and draw in its overlay.
- Live edits (D-07, D-23): with Bun hot reload on (the bin's default) a save of a game source makes Bun reload the game page; the bridge stores a `game.bookmark` checkpoint in `sessionStorage` before and restores it after (hello `manifest.restored`), toast "Game reloaded · state restored". Without it (`--no-hmr`, a game's own server, or no new page within `hotReloadWaitMs`) the editor runs D-07: `game.bookmark` → reload the frame → `game.restore` on reconnect. The session reads tainted. The Hot reload switch (key H) turns it off and on while the bin runs (D-32): Bun cannot change HMR on a running server, so the bin restarts its server with HMR flipped on the same port (token kept, every socket drops for about a second), and the tools page reloads the game frame with its checkpoint, so the page gains or drops `/_bun/client`; toasts "Hot reload off" / "Hot reload on", then "Game reloaded · state restored from the last checkpoint". While off, a save on disk does not reload the game. A game's own server owns it (the switch is inert); a failed switch says to restart the bin with or without `--no-hmr`. Measured on merge-game (e2e/edit-loop.spec.ts): save → updated frame in about 30 ms with the hot swap (a recolour, read back from captured frames, about 0.1 s); a reload with the state restored takes about 0.8 s. Hot swap (game 0.5.0): with `[serve.static] plugins = ["@moku-labs/game/hot"]` in the game root's `bunfig.toml`, a save of a view module (`.tsx`, `styles.ts`, `view.ts`, `animations.ts`, `effects.ts`, generated strings, and since game 0.9.0 a `.ts` directly in `styles/`, `motion/`, `effects/`, `views/`, `world/projections/` or `world/layout/`) swaps in place: same session, no reload, toast "Game updated", and `gameFrame().reload()` resolves `{ restored: false, reason: "hot_swap" }` (it ends on the game's `ui:hot-swap` log entry). A logic module still reloads and restores, also under a popup.
- Only the game reloads (U9): during an expected reload (`link.expectReload()`, close 1012, a game's bye; `isReloading(status)`) the top bar keeps its name, session and pill width, the panels keep their data, and one spinner `[data-frame-reloading]` shows on the game frame. A real loss, or one past link's `reloadGraceMs` (5000), shows the red bar over the workspace, never in the flow.
- Project index (D-38 … D-48): `files` opens the project index of its root on start (`@moku-labs/game/project`); the tools page asks it through `link.files.find(key)` and reads the key maps from `link.project()` (`link:project` with a `ProjectDelta`). It is the only source of code locations (node and flow files, Code tab, Used by, the picked element's JSX and style, projections, text styles, the asset manifest). Index off: one line `Project index is off: <reason>` in every view that needs a location (log `files:project-off` at error); a key it does not know: `Not in the project index: <key>`. No `bunfig.toml` needed for it. Removed: the node → file rule (`nodeFile`, `flowFile`, kebab), crawls, `.moku/editor/files.json`, configs `flowView.stylesFile`, `gameView.manifestPaths`, `gameView.sourceSearch`, `renderView.manifestPaths`. A versioned write checks the version right before the rename (window narrowed, not closed).
- Files sandbox (D-09): `files` works under one root, allowlist + denylist, realpath check, atomic writes, optional sha1 `version`.
- Security: the server binds 127.0.0.1 only; Host, Origin and a per-start 43-char token gate every upgrade. The token is never logged or printed.
- Tools page ships prebuilt (D-06): `bun run build:tools` bundles `src/plugins/pages/page/` into `dist/tools/`; `pages` serves it.

## Quick start

Game page (dev entry; the agent drops out of a production build):

```ts
if (__MOKU_GAME_DEV__) {
  const { bridgePlugin, capturePlugin, createApp } = await import("@moku-labs/editor/agent");
  const editor = createApp({
    plugins: [bridgePlugin, capturePlugin],
    pluginConfigs: { registry: { game: app, modules: [mergeDev], name: "merge-game 0.0.0" } }
  });
  await editor.start(); // after the game; never waits for the editor server
}
```

Server (Bun):

```ts
import { createApp } from "@moku-labs/editor/server";
import index from "./index.html";

const editor = createApp({ pluginConfigs: { files: { root: `${import.meta.dir}/..` } } });
await editor.start();
Bun.serve(editor.hub.serve({ port: 3000, routes: { "/": index }, fetch: serveAsset }));
// tools page: http://127.0.0.1:3000/__editor/
```

Or the bin: `bunx moku-editor --root .` in a moku-game folder (the engine writes the page with the editor's agent), or `bunx moku-editor web/index.html --port 3000 --root .` for a game HTML file.

Tools page (what the prebuilt page does):

```ts
import { createApp } from "@moku-labs/editor/tools";

const tools = createApp({});
await tools.start();
tools.workspace.mount(document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-editor-root]")!);
```

## Quick API reference

### Framework (each entry)

```ts
createApp(options?: { plugins?: Plugin[]; pluginConfigs?: { [plugin]: Partial<Config> } }): App
createPlugin(name: string, spec: { depends?, config?, createState?, api?, hooks?, onInit?, onStart?, onStop? }): Plugin
app.start(): Promise<void>
app.stop(): Promise<void>
app.<pluginName>        // the plugin api, e.g. app.hub, app.link, app.flowView
ctx.require(plugin)     // the api from inside another plugin
```

### Root (`@moku-labs/editor`)

```ts
definePanel(input: PanelInput<S, C>): PanelSpec
checkInput(schema: InputSchema, raw: Json): InputOf<schema>     // throws -32602
toWireValue(value: unknown): Json                               // $map, $set, $error tags; throws -32006
encode(message: Message): string
decode(text: string): Message
request(id, channel, method, params?, session?) / notification(...) / success(id, result) / failure(id, error)
isRequest / isResponse / isNotification / isFailure / isJson
wireError(code: number, message: string, data?: WireErrorData): Error & WireError
isWireError(value): value is WireError
toWireError(error: unknown): WireError
fromWireError(error: WireError): ProtocolError
isRetryable(error: unknown): boolean
bareMessage(message: string): string                            // strips "[moku-editor] "
isReloading(status: LinkStatus): boolean                        // a lost with reloading: true (an expected reload, U7/U9)
isHotSwapEntry(entry: Json): boolean                            // a game.log entry of an applied dev hot swap (ui:hot-swap, game 0.5.0)
errorCode, ERROR_PREFIX, ProtocolError                         // errorCode.notInstalled = -32008
parseProjectState(value) / parseFoundList(value)                // checked copies of editor.project and a find answer; undefined when bad
projectDelta(held, next): ProjectDelta                          // { all, files, moved, removed }: all after a revision gap, first state or off
firstDefinition(state, key): string | undefined                 // the first def path of a key: firstDefinition(link.project(), "node:board/merge")
anchorKey(ref, path): string                                    // the style: / textStyle: key of a style block
// types: ProjectState (off { reason } | on { revision, previous?, manifest?, defs, uses, broken, change? }), ProjectFound
// (path, binding?, key?, component?, kind?, stem?, prop?, line, range, hash, broken?), ProjectAnchor, ProjectDelta, ProjectChange, ProjectMove, FindParams
isSelectionInfo(value) / parseSelectionInfo(value) / parseSelectParams(value)     // SelectionInfo guard and checked copies
```

### Agent APIs

```ts
registry.manifest(): Manifest                    // probes door sources on each build; unavailable ones carry available: false
registry.source(id: string): SourceEntry | undefined
registry.command(id: string): CommandEntry | undefined
registry.add(entry: CommandEntry): void          // in onInit; editor commands only
registry.envelope(): RunState                    // { path, frame, tainted }
registry.clock(): Clock                          // { frame, paused }

channel.read(id: string, input?: Json): Promise<Json>
channel.watch(id: string, input: Json | undefined, onValue: (value: Json) => void): () => void
channel.run(id: string, input?: Json): Promise<RunResult>
channel.status(): LinkStatus
channel.heartbeat(): Heartbeat                   // { frame, paused, at, heap? }
channel.onHeartbeat(fn: HeartbeatListener): () => void

overlay.open(): void
overlay.close(): void
overlay.isOpen(): boolean

bridge.status(): LinkStatus
bridge.session(): string | undefined
```

### Server APIs

```ts
files.list(dir: string): Promise<FileEntry[]>
files.read(path: string): Promise<FileText>                         // { text, version }
files.write(path: string, text: string, version?: string): Promise<WriteResult>
files.writeBinary(path: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<WriteResult>   // .moku/captures/ only
files.readBinary(path: string): Promise<FileBinary>                 // { dataUrl, version }
files.resolve(path: string): string
files.root(): string
files.find(key: string): Promise<ProjectFound[]>                  // lines read from disk now; [] unknown key; -32008 when the index is off
files.project(): ProjectState                                       // the last project-index state

hub.serve(options: ServeOptions): BunServeOptions
hub.token(): string
hub.sessions(): SessionInfo[]
hub.fetch(req: Request, server: HubServer): Response | undefined
hub.websocket: HubWebSocketHandler
hub.addRoutes(routes: EditorRoutes): void
hub.guard(req: Request, server: HubServer, mode: GuardMode): Response | undefined
hub.path(): string
hub.publish<M extends PublishMethod>(method: M, params: PublishParams[M]): void   // "hotReload" | "selection" | "project"; to every tools socket, replayed after each tools hello

pages.routes(): EditorRoutes
pages.attachServer(options, restart?): void   // the bin calls it right after Bun.serve (in the game root: it re-runs itself there for a [serve.static] bunfig); restart lets the switch restart the server
pages.hotReload(): HotReload                     // { hmr, owner: "bin" | "server" }
pages.setHotReload(on: boolean): Promise<boolean> // the bin with its restart: true, then restarts its server with HMR flipped (D-32)
```

### Tools APIs

```ts
link.read / link.watch / link.run / link.status        // remote EditorChannel
link.manifest(): Manifest | undefined
link.onManifest(fn: (manifest: Manifest | undefined) => void): () => void
link.sessions(): readonly SessionInfo[]
link.session(): string | undefined
link.choose(session: string): Promise<Manifest>
link.retry(): void
link.expectReload(): void                         // the next loss reads lost with reloading: true, for reloadGraceMs
link.boot(): ToolsBoot | undefined
link.frameUrl(url: string): string / link.isOtherTab(page: string): boolean
link.onTap(listener: (tap: Tap) => void): () => void
link.heap(): { usedMb, limitMb } | undefined      // Chromium page heap from the last heartbeat
link.files: { list, read, write, writeBinary(path, dataUrl), readBinary, find(key) }
link.project(): ProjectState | undefined           // the last editor.project state, frozen, kept across reconnects
link.hotReload(): HotReload | undefined / onHotReload(listener) / setHotReload(on): Promise<boolean>
link.selection(): SelectionInfo | undefined / notify("selection", info | null) / handle("select", handler): () => void   // the editor page role

workspace.active() / show(ws) / theme() / setTheme(theme?) / density() / setDensity(choice) / preview(ws) / setPreview(ws, patch)
workspace.device() / setDevice(patch) / devices() / gameFrame() / palette.add(item) / palette.open(query?)
workspace.gameFrame().reload({ restore? }): Promise<ReloadResult>   // { restored, reason?: "not_mounted" | "not_embedded" | "no_session" | "bookmark_failed" | "restore_failed" | "timeout" | "hot_swap" }
workspace.toast(message, file?) / mount(element) / host(ws) / badge(ws, badge?) / previewZone(ws, el, insets?)
workspace.keys.bind(binding) / keys.escape(layer, close) / overlayInGame() / setOverlayInGame(on) / reference() / setReference(on) / onPrefs(fn)
workspace.muted() / setMuted(on)                  // the sound flag, persisted; gameView sends game.mute
workspace.setDevice({ preset?, orientation?, folded? }) / hotReload() / setHotReload(on)

panels.register(panel: PanelSpec): void
panels.run(id: string, input?: Json, origin?: PanelRunOrigin): Promise<RunResult>
panels.list(): readonly PanelSpec[]
panels.mountInto(ws: WorkspaceId, element: HTMLElement): () => void

flowView.camera.{ get, fitAll, fitSelection, zoomBy, zoomTo, follow }
flowView.focus.{ select, selected, current, walk, followEdge, focusFrame, step, history }
flowView.flows.{ expand, collapse, enter, up }
flowView.layout.{ pinnedCount, reset }

gameView.pick(on?) / selected() / select(ref?) / inspect(ref) / scene() / locate(ref) / highlight(ref?)
gameView.manifest() / capture() / series({ durationMs, intervalMs, label? }) / stopSeries() / openSheet(indexPath)
gameView.copyReference(): Promise<string | undefined>   // writes the card of the selection, puts its one line on the clipboard, returns the line
gameView.fold(inner?) / bookmarks(): readonly PickBookmark[]   // { id, frame, key, at, value }, newest first, 20 at most

renderView.refresh() / snapshot() / reveal(ref) / highlight(ref?) / sortTextures(key) / filterBundle(bundle)
// snapshot().tiles.heap: { kind: "value", usedMb, limitMb } in Chromium, else { kind: "absent" }; tiles.effectsInstalled: false without effectsPlugin

stateView.lastCommit() / note() / onCommit(fn) / tainted() / graph() / expanded(pointer, depth) / setExpanded(pointer, open) / expandAll(root, open)

filesView.open(path, { line?, edit? }?) / close(path, { discard? }?) / activate(path) / tabs() / active() / edit(on, path?)
filesView.setBuffer(path, text) / setMode(path, mode) / save(path?) / resolveConflict(path, choice) / refresh() / files()
filesView.fileOf(ref) / flowFileOf(flow) / usedBy(path) / editorUrl(path, line?) / subscribe(fn)

consoleView.lines() / visible() / counts() / filter() / setFilter(next) / clear() / preserve() / setPreserve(on)
consoleView.select(key?) / selected() / refresh() / focusFrame(frame) / subscribe(fn)
```

## Global events

Declared in `src/config.ts`; no plugin declares its own events.

```ts
type AgentEvents = {
  "bridge:status": { status: LinkStatus; session?: string };
};
type ServerEvents = {
  "hub:session": HubSession;       // { id, game, open, reason?: "bye" | "game_reloaded" }
  "files:written": FilesWritten;   // { path, bytes, kind: "code" | "style" | "layout" | "capture" | "other" }
  "files:project": ProjectState;   // the project index opened, changed (a watch batch) or went off
};
type ToolsEvents = {
  "link:status": { status: LinkStatus; session?: string };
  "link:project": { state: ProjectState; delta: ProjectDelta };   // a new editor.project state; views drop what delta names
  "workspace:changed": { ws: WorkspaceId };
  "workspace:ran": RanEvent;
  "workspace:density": { density: "compact" | "comfortable" };
  "workspace:reference": { on: boolean };
  "workspace:open-file": { path: string; line?: number };
  "workspace:select-node": { id: string };
  "workspace:focus-frame": { frame: number };
  "workspace:reveal": { ref: ElementRef };
  "workspace:inspect": { ref: ElementRef };
  "workspace:open-sheet": { index: string };
};
```

## Plugins (17)

One line each: core · tier · purpose · key methods · events (E = emits, H = hooks).

### Agent core (`editor-agent`)

- registry · agent · Complex · wraps game doors, `.dev` modules and `editor.*` commands into entries; builds the Manifest; probes door sources (not installed → `available: false`, -32008); owns `./protocol` · `manifest`, `source`, `command`, `add`, `envelope`, `clock` · no events
- channel · agent · Standard · in-process EditorChannel: immediate read on watch, run in a microtask, timer heartbeat (default 1000 ms, `heap` in Chromium) · `read`, `watch`, `run`, `status`, `heartbeat`, `onHeartbeat` · no events
- overlay · agent · Standard · Preact card over the game: render chips and one-click cheats; off by default; adds command `editor.overlay` · `open`, `close`, `isOpen` · H `bridge:status`
- bridge · agent · Complex · opt-in websocket to the hub: hello, requests, throttled values, taps (≤ 1 per 50 ms), backoff 1 s → 30 s, a checkpoint in sessionStorage across Bun's reload; adds command `editor.reload { restore? }` (checkpoint, then `location.reload()`) · `status`, `session` · E `bridge:status`
- capture · agent · Standard · opt-in; adds `editor.capture { maxWidth?, key?, rect?, format?, quality? }` (JPEG 0.8 by default; `key` or `rect` crops plus 8 px), `editor.series`, `editor.seriesStop`, `editor.sheet { frames, everyMs, maxWidth?, format?, quality? }` (one `game.capture { sheet }`, game ≥ 0.4); `maxWidth` (64–4096) shrinks the picture in the page; never captures on its own; takes `game.capture` as a data URL (game 0.1) or `{ png }` (game 0.4) · no app api · no events

### Server core (`editor-server`)

- files · server · Standard · project-root sandbox: list, read, atomic write with sha1 version, image captures under `.moku/captures/`, the project index of the root (opened on start, kept fresh by its watch) · `list`, `read`, `write`, `writeBinary`, `readBinary`, `resolve`, `root`, `find`, `project` · E `files:written`, `files:project`
- hub · server · Complex · websocket switchboard: guard, token, sessions (with the `heartbeat { frame, paused, silent }` readout), routing of `game` and `files` channels, shared watches, heartbeat and tap fan-out, backpressure, the `hotReload` notification, the editor page's `selection` (kept, replayed) and the `editor.select` relay to the page (`role=page`, D-33); wraps `Bun.serve` · `serve`, `token`, `sessions`, `fetch`, `websocket`, `addRoutes`, `guard`, `publish`, `path` · E `hub:session`; H `files:project` (published as `editor.project`)
- pages · server · Complex · serves the prebuilt tools page with the boot JSON, `/assets/*`, `/hello` and `/hmr`; home of the `moku-editor` bin (Bun hot reload on, switched by restarting its server, D-32; `--no-hmr` starts it off), the `.moku/editor.json` discovery file and the stdio MCP bridge (`mcp/`) · `routes`, `attachServer`, `hotReload`, `setHotReload` · no events

### Tools core (`editor-tools`)

- link · tools · Complex · the tools page's only connection: boot JSON, socket, session choice, remote EditorChannel, files client, link status, taps and heap; a -32008 watch is not logged or retried · `read`, `watch`, `run`, `status`, `manifest`, `onManifest`, `sessions`, `session`, `choose`, `retry`, `boot`, `frameUrl`, `isOtherTab`, `onTap`, `heap`, `files`, `hotReload`, `onHotReload`, `setHotReload`, `selection`, `notify`, `handle` (the editor page role: publishes the selection, answers `editor.select`), `project` · E `link:status`, `link:project`
- workspace · tools · Complex · the shell: top bar (compact with a ⋯ menu below 900 px), rail (Game first and default), palette, toasts, keys, Esc unwinding, prefs (theme, density, preview, device and fold, Show taps, sound), twenty-one device presets (default iPhone 18 Pro), the compact bar's Reference and Hot reload icons, one game iframe with a playable pinned preview, tap ripples, Reference mode, D-07 reload and Bun hot reload, overlay-in-game and Hot reload switches · `show`, `density`, `setDensity`, `reference`, `setReference`, `device`, `setDevice`, `devices`, `gameFrame`, `palette`, `toast`, `keys`, `mount`, `host`, `badge`, `setOverlayInGame`, `hotReload`, `setHotReload` · E `workspace:changed`, `workspace:ran`, `workspace:density`, `workspace:reference`; H `link:status`
- panels · tools · Standard · panel host for `definePanel` specs; holds `shared/` view modules (scene, style edit, highlight, `SidePanel`) · `register`, `run`, `list`, `mountInto` · E `workspace:ran`; H `link:status`, `workspace:changed`
- flowView · tools · VeryComplex · Flow workspace: flow-graph canvas with ELK (spacing by density, labels never overlap), focus, Info-tab neighbours with followEdge (frames both ends, pulse), Find current, trail, an item holding the current node is never dimmed and says "here", code and style inspector · `camera`, `focus`, `flows`, `layout` · E `workspace:open-file`; H `link:status`, `link:project`, `workspace:changed`, `workspace:select-node`, `workspace:focus-frame`, `workspace:density`
- gameView · tools · Complex · Game workspace (the default): device stage (grouped presets, one Fit scale per kind, modern and home-button frames, Fold/Unfold), Sound switch, picker, style card, Code section, Reference mode proxies and area drags, a pick that bookmarks, saves two JPEGs, writes the card file and copies one line, the selection published to MCP and answered `editor.select`, screenshots, series, compact capture card, contact sheet · `pick`, `inspect`, `scene`, `locate`, `highlight`, `capture`, `series`, `stopSeries`, `openSheet`, `copyReference`, `fold`, `bookmarks` · E `workspace:reveal`, `workspace:open-file`; H `link:status`, `link:project`, `workspace:changed`, `workspace:open-sheet`, `workspace:inspect`, `workspace:reference`
- renderView · tools · Standard · Render workspace: tiles (JS heap in Chromium, FPS rest note, "Effects not installed in this game"), render tree, textures, bundles, pools, release log · `refresh`, `snapshot`, `reveal`, `highlight`, `sortTextures`, `filterBundle` · E `workspace:inspect`; H `workspace:changed`, `link:status`, `link:project`, `workspace:reveal`
- stateView · tools · Standard · State workspace: player/session trees, last commit derived by diffing `game.model`, runner card · `lastCommit`, `note`, `onCommit`, `tainted`, `graph`, `expanded`, `setExpanded`, `expandAll` · H `link:status`, `workspace:ran`
- filesView · tools · Complex · Files workspace: tree, tabs, viewer, editor, previews, conflict bar, Used by · `open`, `close`, `save`, `resolveConflict`, `refresh`, `fileOf`, `flowFileOf`, `usedBy`, `editorUrl`, `subscribe` · E `workspace:select-node`, `workspace:open-sheet`; H `link:status`, `link:project`, `workspace:changed`, `workspace:open-file`
- consoleView · tools · Standard · Console workspace: `game.log` table, level filter, search, Preserve log, command errors, rail badge · `lines`, `visible`, `counts`, `setFilter`, `clear`, `setPreserve`, `refresh`, `focusFrame`, `subscribe` · E `workspace:focus-frame`; H `link:status`, `workspace:ran`

## Dependency graph and init order

```
agent:  registry → channel → overlay            (bridge, capture opt-in)
        bridge  depends [registry, channel]
        capture depends [registry]
server: files → hub → pages                     (pages depends [files, hub])
tools:  link → workspace → panels → flowView, gameView, renderView, stateView, filesView, consoleView
        every view depends [link, panels]; all but stateView also [workspace]
```

## Wire

- Socket URL: `{path}/ws?token=<t>&kind=agent|tools` (default path `/__editor`). Hello: `GET {path}/hello` → `{ ws, token }`.
- Agent → hub: `hello { manifest }` (first, else close 1008), `heartbeat`, `value { sub, value }`, `tap { x, y, at }`, `bye`.
- Hub → agent: requests `manifest`, `read`, `watch`, `unwatch`, `run` (channel `game`); notification `session` (channel `editor`).
- Tools → hub: `game` channel `manifest`, `read`, `run`, `watch`, `unwatch`; `files` channel `list`, `read`, `write`, `writeBinary`, `readBinary`, `find { key }`.
- Hub → tools: `sessions { list }` (each `SessionInfo` with `heartbeat { frame, paused, silent }` once known and `manifestHash`, the `commandsHash` of its commands, set on hello; re-sent when paused or silent flips), `session`, `hotReload { hmr, owner }`, `project` (the `ProjectState`, kept and replayed; channel `editor`), forwarded `heartbeat`, `value` and `tap`.
- Long calls: a `run` of `editor.series` waits `durationMs`, a `run` of `editor.sheet` `frames × everyMs`, on top of the call deadline (capped at +60 s) in bridge, hub and link.
- Error codes: -32600 invalid request, -32601 unknown method/id, -32602 invalid input, -32000 command failed, -32001 game reloaded (retryable), -32002 timeout / link closed (retryable), -32003 no session / choose session, -32004 forbidden path, -32005 version conflict, -32006 not JSON, -32007 unauthorized, -32008 not installed (the game does not have the source). Every message starts with `[moku-editor] `.

## MCP for Claude Code

- Setup in the game folder: `claude mcp add moku-editor -- bunx moku-editor mcp web/index.html --port 3000`, or a `.mcp.json` with `{ "mcpServers": { "moku-editor": { "type": "stdio", "command": "bunx", "args": ["moku-editor", "mcp", "web/index.html", "--port", "3000"] } } }` (`moku-editor mcp-config` prints it). `claude mcp list` then shows `moku-editor … ✔ Connected`. Add `.moku/` to the game's `.gitignore`.
- The bridge (`src/plugins/pages/mcp/`) is a separate process and a hub tools client. Newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdio; stdout carries only protocol frames. Protocol versions `2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18`, `2025-03-26`. Claude Code 2.1.280 probes `server/discover` first (answered -32601), then sends `initialize` 2025-11-25 (fixtures in `src/plugins/pages/__tests__/fixtures/`).
- Which editor: a live `<root>/.moku/editor.json` (`{ version, pid, port, url, ws, token, root, html, startedAt }`, 0600, written by the bin, removed on stop) wins; otherwise the bridge starts `moku-editor <html> --port <port> --root <root>` itself (log `.moku/editor.log`) and owns it. On stdin end, SIGINT or SIGTERM it aborts pending calls, closes the socket and stops only a bin it started; exit 0.
- Generic tools (17): `moku_status`, `moku_sessions` (with `heartbeat` and `manifestHash`), `moku_manifest`, `moku_read`, `moku_wait`, `moku_run`, `moku_screenshot` (`editor.capture`, JPEG by default, max width 1080, `key` crops to one ui element; over 300 KB taken once more at half width), `moku_series` (`editor.sheet` at 1080 px wide as JPEG, or `game.capture { sheet }` for an agent without it; game ≥ 0.4), `moku_reference` (the newest or a named card of `.moku/captures/<yyyy-mm-dd>/`, newest day first, and of the older flat `.moku/captures/`), `moku_selection` (the editor page's `SelectionInfo` and its crop), `moku_select` (`{ key }` or `{ rect }`, relayed to the editor page, which picks it; the selection with its card and crop), `moku_files_list`, `moku_files_read`, `moku_files_write`, `moku_reload`, `moku_start`, `moku_stop`. `.moku/editor.json` and `.moku/editor.log` are hidden from and refused by the file tools.
- Door tools (D-35, D-36, D-37): after the 17 generic tools, `tools/list` holds one tool per command door of the selected session (the one `moku_run` uses without `session`: the only one, else the embedded one; several and none embedded: none). Name: the id with `.` as `_` (`game.tap` → `game_tap`); cheat and raw doors carry the effect first (`cheat_game_fill`, `raw_game_restore`). Typed input schema per door field, optional `_session`; the answer reads like `moku_run`. No tool for the doors the generic tools cover (`game.capture`, `editor.capture`, `editor.sheet`, `editor.series`, `editor.seriesStop`, `editor.reload`; screenshots go only through `moku_screenshot`, JPEG by default, about 300 KB at most), a name starting with `moku_` or longer than 40, an id outside `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, a field `_session` or outside `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}`, two doors of one name; each is logged once on stderr and `moku_run` still runs it. The hub stamps `SessionInfo.manifestHash` (`commandsHash` of the session's commands); the bridge rebuilds the door tools and sends `notifications/tools/list_changed` only when that hash moves (a 5 s grace keeps the set while no session is chosen, so a hot reload of the same game changes nothing). The first `tools/list` waits at most 3 s for them. `initialize` carries `instructions` on generic versus door tools. Deny the cheat and raw doors with `{ "permissions": { "deny": ["mcp__moku-editor__cheat_*", "mcp__moku-editor__raw_*"] } }`. A client that does not refresh after `list_changed` keeps the old list; a gone door answers `isError`, and `moku_run` runs every door.
- Pictures need the game page visible: a paused or hidden game answers `isError` "game paused or hidden at frame N — bring the editor pane to front or resume".

## File structure

```
src/
  config.ts          three createCoreConfig calls, AgentEvents/ServerEvents/ToolsEvents, createAgentPlugin/createServerPlugin/createToolsPlugin
  index.ts           package root: protocol types and helpers, definePanel
  agent.ts           @moku-labs/editor/agent
  agent-page.ts      @moku-labs/editor/agent/page (default export: the engine's PageAgent)
  server.ts          @moku-labs/editor/server
  tools.ts           @moku-labs/editor/tools
  plugins/
    index.ts         barrel of all 17 instances and type namespaces (imported by no entry)
    registry/        + protocol/ (types, errors, check, wire-value, messages, project, devices, overlay-host)
    channel/ overlay/ bridge/ capture/
    files/ hub/ pages/   (pages: page/ = the tools page source, bin.ts + cli.ts = moku-editor, engine-page.ts = the engine page, mcp/ = the stdio MCP bridge)
    link/ workspace/ (styles/ = shared CSS layer) panels/ (shared/ = view modules, icons, workspaces)
    flowView/ gameView/ renderView/ stateView/ filesView/ consoleView/
    <name>/__tests__/unit, __tests__/integration
tests/
  unit/              framework-level unit tests
  integration/       root stack tests (helpers/stack.ts: startStack, shutdown); tiny game in CI, merge-game locally;
                     agent-bundle.test.ts (needs `bun run build`), not-installed.test.ts, mcp-bridge.test.ts (bin + bridge processes),
                     agent-page.test.ts, tree-bundle.test.ts (tsdown once when dist/agent-page.mjs is missing)
  fixtures/          tiny-screen-game.tsx; moku-game.ts (a moku-game folder for the engine page tests)
scripts/build-tools.ts   bundles the tools page into dist/tools
scripts/tree/bundle.ts   the editor tree's serve plugin for the engine page (D-50); repo only, not in the package
```

## Scripts

`bun run build` (tsdown + build:tools) · `bun run build:tools` · `bun run typecheck` · `bun run test` · `bun run test:unit` · `bun run test:integration` · `bun run test:coverage` · `bun run test:e2e` (Playwright: four Chromium windows 480–1440 px; e2e/edit-loop.spec.ts prints save → frame ms per edit) · `bun run lint` · `bun run lint:fix` · `bun run format` · `bun run validate`
